subject: S16 contracts: sw.ts push-only, plan_item outbox LWW, planner_items placement, Alembic 0022; S16 needs a Settings 'Study plan' group
body:
# S16 day-one contracts

**To seg18-offline — service worker file.** S16 creates `apps/web/src/sw.ts` (vite-plugin-pwa 2.0.0, `strategies: 'injectManifest'`, `srcDir: 'src'`, `filename: 'sw.ts'`) containing ONLY `push` and `notificationclick` handlers plus `self.skipWaiting`-free lifecycle (no precache, no fetch handler, no `clientsClaim`). Push payload: `{ "k": "<ui_copy key>", "n": {numbers}, "url": "/today" }`; the SW looks the title/body up from a copy table the page posts into IndexedDB-free `postMessage`? No: copy strings are inlined in the payload as `title`/`body` already resolved server-side from ui_copy templates (numbers only, no note text). S18 adds precache + runtime caching to the SAME file below a marked `// ── S18: caching ──` comment and may set `injectionPoint`; S16 does not touch the file after it lands. The web manifest is generated by the plugin config in `apps/web/vite.config.ts` (S16 adds the plugin; S18 owns precache/globPatterns thereafter).

**To seg18-offline — outbox entity `plan_item`.** Replay op: `PATCH /api/plan/items/{id}` body `{ "status": "planned"|"done"|"skipped", "client_updated_at_ms": <int ms> }`. Last-writer-wins per row: the server keeps `plan_items.client_updated_at_ms`; a request with a strictly newer stamp wins, an equal or older one is ignored and the response returns the stored row with `applied: false` (tie → server wins). Idempotent, so safe to replay. Status is the only client-writable field. Web helper: `apps/web/src/planner/api.ts` exports `patchPlanItem(id, status, clientUpdatedAtMs)`; S18 can queue it as `entity: "plan_item"` keyed by item id (latest op per id wins).

**To seg15-ingest — placement `planner_items`.** Proposal shape the placement should hand to the planner for a confirmed timetable: a list of `{ "day": "YYYY-MM-DD", "kind": "read|questions|cards|video|admin", "title": str(<=200), "target_minutes": int|null }`. Apply it through `POST /api/plan/items` (student items, `origin='user'`, one per call, or `items: [...]` up to 50 in one call) after the student confirms; S16 exposes `naadi_api.plan.student_items.create_items(conn, user_id, items)` for in-process use. Dates outside the active plan's span are rejected (422).

**Migration.** S16 claims Alembic 0022 and sets `down_revision` to the real head at integrate time.
